# Pandamonium v1.0.46

This release makes deep research an agent-decided capability, compacts the composer model selector to the approved design, and moves the access shield to the More-tools control where it belongs.

## MAD-887 — Research: make deep-research tools always agent-available by intent

### Problem

Research requests such as "research X", "look into Y", and "deep dive on Z" were classified to the web domain only. The deep-research tools (`trigger_research` and `manage_research`) reached the model only when retrieval or the keyword fallback happened to select them, so the agent sometimes answered a research request with a single web lookup instead of starting a research job.

### Implementation

A dedicated `research` domain now seeds both deep-research tools whenever research intent fires, with a matching prompt rule pack. The classification adds the research domain alongside web for "research", "deep dive", "investigate", and "look into" phrasing. No new user toggle exists; the agent decides when deep research is needed, matching the always-on treatment shell and web received.

### Product value and UI visibility

Asking the agent to research a topic now reliably starts a job that streams progress in the Deep Research sidebar and produces a report, instead of a one-off quick search. There is no new UI control; the change is in routing behavior.

### Verification

Deterministic tests cover research-intent classification across four phrasings and the domain tool map. The full Python suite passes (5,612 passed, 5 skipped), and the full browser suite passes (97/97).

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Server-side policy still applies: an operator who disabled research tools or lacks the research privilege is unaffected. The legacy per-message research flag and the inert hidden checkbox are untouched.

### References

- [Linear MAD-887](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-887/research-make-deep-research-tools-always-agent-available-by-intent)
- [Fix PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/67)

## MAD-888 — UI: compact approved model selector with capability-aware effort footer

### Problem

The composer's picker popover spent most of its height on the oversized work-budget card and had no visual marker for the current choice. The approved mockup called for a compact panel with clear selected state.

### Implementation

The popover is now a compact 380px charcoal panel with a thin crimson outline and an 18px radius, a "Select a model" heading, and compact option rows showing the existing identity/model icon, display name, and real secondary text. The current selection gets a dark-red tint, red outline, and a checkmark (rows now carry `aria-selected`). The footer slider keeps its honest capability mapping: reasoning effort for native Codex targets and agent work budget for Jarvis. The installation work-budget control remains in Settings. Routing, discovery, search, keyboard navigation, loading/empty/failure states, and mobile bounds are unchanged.

### Product value and UI visibility

The picker is scannable and compact, opens above the composer button, shows the current choice at a glance, and no longer buries the list under a large budget card. The effort footer reflects what the selected target actually supports instead of pretending a work budget is reasoning effort.

### Verification

The full browser suite passes 97/97, including the selector's identity-list, keyboard, mobile-bounds, and unavailable-state specs; the m7 workspace theme test was updated to the approved 18px radius. New source guards pin the heading, selected-row affordance, and compact overrides.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

The option list remains the real conversation-identity and model catalog; the mockup's model names were illustrative. No behavior or routing change. Long lists scroll inside the panel, and narrow viewports keep the panel inside the window.

### References

- [Linear MAD-888](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-888/ui-compact-approved-model-selector-with-capability-aware-effort-footer)
- [Feature PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/69)

## MAD-889 — Authority: place the access shield beside the composer More-tools control

### Problem

The access-level shield shipped beside the Jarvis sphere, but the intended placement is next to the More-tools control in the composer's left cluster.

### Implementation

The button markup moved from the right cluster to immediately right of the More-tools chevron in the left cluster. The floating menu remains positioned from the button's live rect, so opening above the shield, persistence, and Escape/outside-click dismissal are unchanged.

### Product value and UI visibility

The shield now sits where the composer's utility controls live, matching the operator's layout. No behavior change.

### Verification

The source guard and browser spec assert the new left-cluster geometry; both pass locally, and the full suite passed before merge.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Placement only. Operator visual confirmation on the installed build remains.

### References

- [Linear MAD-889](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-889/authority-place-the-access-shield-beside-the-composer-more-tools)
- [Fix PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/71)
